description: Rename a part display name on the working copy. part_id is an opaque surf id; a path or name is unknown_part. Response { partId, name, moved: false }. No git write; the committed header updates on the next git_save. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

name.description: New display name. Working copy only; Save writes the same f(id) file.

part_id.description: Part id from parts. Not a vault path.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: rename_part
